reading.title: Letter regarding Payments in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) Agreement for Queens Park Plaza Apartments

candidates.quote: The Project is a ninety-four (94) unit garden style apartment community, a portion of which will provide affordable housing for fifty seven (57) low-income to moderate-income households.
candidates.wording: will provide affordable housing for fifty seven (57) low-income to moderate-income households

candidates.quote: The Project is a ninety-four (94) unit garden style apartment community, a portion of which will provide affordable housing for fifty seven (57) low-income to moderate-income households.

The PILOT will require the Owner to make a mandatory annual payment to the County in an amount of no less than approximately seventeen thousand, one hundred dollars ($17,100), or approximately three hundred dollars ($300) per unit, for the fifty-seven (57) affordable units for the first full tax year.
candidates.wording: mandatory annual payment to the County in an amount of no less than approximately seventeen thousand, one hundred dollars ($17,100)
candidates.value: $17,100 or $300 per unit for the first full tax year

candidates.quote: Thereafter, the required payment will increase by two percent (2%) for each subsequent tax year.
candidates.wording: increase by two percent (2%) for each subsequent tax year

candidates.quote: The PILOT agreement will remain in effect for fifteen (15) years.
candidates.wording: remain in effect for fifteen (15) years

candidates.quote: When considering the financial effects of the PILOT, the County will be providing yearly operating support of approximately twenty-nine thousand, two hundred seventy-seven dollars ($29,277) to this affordable housing development.
candidates.wording: County will be providing yearly operating support of approximately twenty-nine thousand, two hundred seventy-seven dollars ($29,277)
